findings.body:
**Move enrollment after the clone setup and the head re-check, just before dispatch.**

`src/ops/review/addressMany.ts:417` sends the queue `enqueue` request before `isolateAddressMany` runs (line 428) and before the head re-check (lines 447-462). When the clone setup refuses, enrollment has already happened. For example, an `IsolationRefusal` from repo-local `credential.helper` settings fails every PR the same way. The same applies when the PR head moves before dispatch. In both cases the queue keeps a request for a leg that never dispatched, and the row reports `enrollment: { state: 'enrolled' }`.

This contradicts the file's own default. `requestedEnrollment` reports `'Requested but leg not dispatched'` as `unavailable` (line 373). Move the enrollment block into the `else` branch at line 463, before `dispatched = true`. Enrollment then becomes part of the dispatch, and a refused or stale leg keeps the `unavailable` default.
findings.title: Move enrollment after the clone setup and the head re-check, just before dispatch.

findings.body:
**Add a timeout and disable terminal prompts for the Git subprocesses that set up each clone.**

`src/ops/review/addressMany.ts:80` creates `git` as `promisify(execFile)` with no `timeout`. The same pattern appears at line 335. Every Git call in `isolateAddressMany` therefore has no time limit. That includes the network call `git fetch origin` at lines 144-150. The environment does not set `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`. Git asks for credentials through `/dev/tty`, not stdin. On an interactive terminal, a private remote with no usable credential stops on that prompt.

When this happens, the worker never leaves `isolateAddressMany`. Its reservation stays in `budget.outstanding`. Other workers that hit `over-limit` put their candidate back and exit at lines 386-389. The whole bulk run then hangs. `input.wallMs` limits only `address`, not the clone setup. The `gh` runners in this file use `timeoutMs: 30_000`, so the Git calls are the only external calls without a time limit.

<details>
<summary>🛡️ Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-  const git = promisify(execFile);
+  const exec = promisify(execFile);
+  const git = (file: string, args: string[]) =>
+    exec(file, args, {
+      timeout: 300_000,
+      env: { ...process.env, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0' },
+    });
```
</details>
findings.title: Add a timeout and disable terminal prompts for the Git subprocesses that set up each clone.
